description: Prepare and execute a new release of the Astro packages, updating version numbers and changelogs based on accumulated changesets. This release includes bug fixes for the core framework and the Cloudflare adapter.
functional_requirements: Update the version numbers and changelogs for the 'astro' and '@astrojs/cloudflare' packages according to the changesets
Apply the documented bug fixes: correct frontmatter 'return;' syntax handling in the core framework and ensure the Cloudflare adapter only adds SESSION KV bindings when appropriate
Update all example project dependencies to reference the new package versions
